findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_companies" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search for companies by name or ticker symbol. Returns matching entities with CIK, all known names, and ticker symbols, plus the SEC's SIC industry code and nam…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_filings, list_sic_codes, get_document, get_filing_item, get_insider_transactions, get_financial_statements, get_financial_history · Private data: search_filings, get_filings, get_filing_detail, get_document, list_filing_items, get_filing_item, list_filing_tables, get_holdings, get_fiscal_calendar, search_private_offerings, get_private_offering, get_financial_statements, search_document, verify_quote, verify_figure, list_figures, check_citations · Public sink: search_filings, get_holdings, get_institutional_holders, get_insider_transactions, get_shares_outstanding, get_financial_statements, get_financial_history · Destructive: get_holdings, list_figures.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_filings, list_sic_codes, get_document, get_filing_item, get_insider_transactions, get_financial_statements, get_financial_history · Private data: search_filings, get_filings, get_filing_detail, get_document, list_filing_items, get_filing_item, list_filing_tables, get_holdings, get_fiscal_calendar, search_private_offerings, get_private_offering, get_financial_statements, search_document, verify_quote, verify_figure, list_figures, check_citations · Public sink: search_filings, get_holdings, get_institutional_holders, get_insider_transactions, get_shares_outstanding, get_financial_statements, get_financial_history · Destructive: get_holdings, list_figures

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
